name: WCORR-SSH-004: SSH login, sudo and sensitive file modification
description: Detects a three-stage sequence involving remote access, privilege use and modification of security-sensitive files.
query:
sequence by agent.id.keyword with maxspan=30m
  [any where rule.id.keyword == "5715"]
  [any where rule.id.keyword in ("5402", "5407")]
  [any where
    rule.id.keyword in ("550", "554") and
    (
      syscheck.path.keyword in (
        "/etc/passwd",
        "/etc/shadow",
        "/etc/group",
        "/etc/gshadow",
        "/etc/sudoers"
      ) or
      syscheck.path.keyword like "/etc/sudoers.d/*" or
      syscheck.path.keyword like "/home/*/.ssh/authorized_keys" or
      syscheck.path.keyword == "/root/.ssh/authorized_keys"
    )
  ]
author: Wazuh EQL Correlation
false_positives: Agent and time correlation does not prove actor or session continuity. Unlike SSH-003 this source has no realtime FIM predicate; scheduled observation timing can misattribute changes. Legitimate administration can match.
setup: Collect SSH, sudo and sensitive-path FIM alerts; assess scheduled FIM observation delays.
